reviews.x: I bought the trio and there was one pump in one product completely empty. Appears the packaging is what I paid for! Unfortunately, I can rub a bottle on my face. Terrible marketing.

In the MIni Universal Essentials Kit, 3 items were in there. However,  the Universal Moisture Essence bottle was completely devoid of product, nada, zilch. The othere 2 products were fine. The Universal C Skin Refiner was smooth and soft but I pretty sure it was primer in there that made it soft and smooth. The Pro-Bio Moisture Boost Cream was nice.

reviews.t: This Vitamin C is the real deal
reviews.x: I bought this mini pack because I was about to travel.  I have used the products before and it is pretty expensive BUT what I will say is that this Vitamin C saved my skin!! I have always had great skin, no blemishes, no acne, no problems. In the midst of covid my skin became a real problem, with the masks causing acne and blemishes I thought would be scars for some time. My esthetician suggested I try a Vitamin C.  After doing my homework I landed on Beautystat and was amazed at the results.  T
The vitamin C seems gritty and doesn't pair well in layering.  the other 2 products seem okay, moisturizing.  Not sure if I will keep as I think I have found another brand I prefer.

reviews.t: This new product really works to renew your skin
reviews.x: I first saw this product on an infomercial and low and behold amazon had it First time I tried it on my face it made a big difference, my face felt soft and renewed without the irritating perfume scent, it was even brighter just like they advertised It didn't have that heavy sticky feel like most products I'm a black woman and I feel like this product was made just for me although it's for all skin types!

I'm black, glad I tried the trial size first. I'm not impressed. The moisturizer feels good, it isn't greasy. The Vitamin C has a silk pasty feeling, not too heavy. It made my face tingle a bit. If interested in trying I suggest this small size first. If you don't like it you can use it for hand cream. It's definitely small in size, but a little goes along way. Good luck!

reviews.t: So glad I tried this product!

As a result I approve and I will be purchasing more as a kits. Thank you

I absolutely fell in love with this product. The Vitamin serum goes on so smoothly and I can really see a difference. I have now invested in the larger size Vitamin serum and moisturizer and I love them both. I would absolutely recommend these products.

reviews.t: Real Benefits-Fades Dark Spots, Helps Even Skin Tone, Softer & Firmer Skin, Lasting Hydration
reviews.x: This Beauty Stat Universal Essentials kit includes generous mini sizes of the Universal C Skin Refiner Serum with 20% L-Ascorbic Acid, Universal Moisture Essence (100% Squalane from sugar) and Universal Moisture Boost Cream. These fragrance free products are exceptional for my hyperpigmentation and skin tone issues, dry skin and skin texture. These don’t irritate my dry and sensitive skin and seem well suited to any skin types.  I’ve used 20% L-Ascorbic acid for many years and worked up from 5%

I discovered this brand through my ipsy bag, and was excited to try a few more best sellers from this brand. I personally love the vitamin c serum and the moisture boost cream. The squalene oil is great to mix with foundations that are a bit too drying without disturbing the coverage level or texture. Overall, great set.

Love these products but was very disappointed when I opened cream, container was all but empty. I’ve been using these products for more than two years and this has never happened the vitamin C had very few days use as well. May have been manufacturing issue but $40. for nothing is not ok.

reviews.t: BeautyStat Mini Universal Essentials Skin Care Kit
reviews.x: This is a 3 piece mini set that includes Universal C Skin Refiner, Universal Pro Bio Moisture Boost Cream, Universal Moisture Essence. When you use these products, you will have moisturized skin all day long and you will reap the benefits of rejuvenated, nourished skin.

This is my third order for all three products and I don't see a difference yet. I use as instructed morning and night.  Sorry, no significant changes to my facial or neck dark spots as advertised.  There is no bad odor and the moisturizer doesn't last as long as I need.

claims.text: Several customers received kits with one product completely empty, describing the packaging as what they paid for.
Many reviewers praise the Vitamin C serum and trio for making skin smooth, soft, brighter, and glowing without a greasy feel.
Some customers find the Vitamin C gritty or oddly textured and note it doesn't layer well.
Reviewers appreciate that the mini/trial size let them test the products before committing to full size.
A few customers were unimpressed with how their skin felt or disliked the ingredients, and said they would not repurchase.
